invariants.rationale: The method returns at least getMinHeight(), as result is computed using Math.max(getMinHeight(), ...) at the final return.
Since getMinHeight(), v, and paddings are all likely non-negative, and result is a max over getMinHeight() and a sum of non-negative terms, result is non-negative.
Since result is Math.max(getMinHeight(), v + padTop.get(this) + padBottom.get(this)), it is always at least as large as v plus the paddings.
This exactly describes the returned value as implemented in the return statement.
